title: [3.3.1.0] Auto ISF in APS cannot be selected anymore
body:
I updated AAPS to 3.3.0.0 
2 days ago. There I changed APS to AutoISF and it worked !!

Yesterday I updated to 3.3.1.0. Now I'm missing the option to activate AutoISF. It is not delivered in the configuration anymore.

After reinstalling 3.3.0.0 AutoISF can be used.

![20250108_081944](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a8caa706-9ed6-4bc1-bfd7-70f1142a3a78)

comments.body:
Are you sure your 3.3.0.0 wasn't dev? AutoISF is not released yet.
In dev you can enable AutoISF, in master you should not be able to do so.
